purpose: Define the presentation-only scale and layout contract for visualizing each verified Tier4 final-job Hero-body stat as a horizontal relative-strength bar on Hero detail pages.

scale.domainSource: Use the authoritative global min and max for the same stat from data/generated/hero-final-job-extrema.v1.json.
scale.valueSource: Use the exact candidate values already projected from the B3 consumer for the displayed final-job row.
scale.formula: ratio = (value - min) / (max - min); barPercent = clamp(25 + ratio * 75, 25, 100)
scale.interpretation: The bar visualizes the candidate's relative position within the global Tier4 Normal + RELEASED SP distribution for that same stat. Percent widths are not comparable as absolute units across different stats.
requiredFixtures: equal stat values -> equal bar widths
values outside the domain are clamped but must be treated as a validator failure against the current B3 authority

layout.unit: one final-job card/block per B3 candidate row
layout.rows: six stat rows stacked vertically inside each final-job card
layout.numericValueAuthority: exact B3 candidate value; never derive a display value from the bar width
layout.mobileScope: sanity only; prevent destructive overflow or disappearing content, while detailed responsive optimization is deferred

variantPresentation.normal: Visible in the normal Hero detail presentation.
variantPresentation.spCurrentTemporaryPolicy: RELEASED SP final-job cards remain visibly rendered alongside Normal cards for this implementation so the bar presentation can be inspected before SP mode exists.
variantPresentation.spTargetFuturePolicy: When a dedicated [SP로 전환] interaction is implemented, SP-specific job/stat/bar presentation is expected to move into that SP presentation state.

required: 25%-100% linear visual scale is explicitly frozen
each stat uses only its own B3 global min/max domain
displayed values remain exact B3 candidate values
3-B final-job card layout and left-bar/right-number placement are frozen
temporary visible SP policy and future SP-toggle handoff are explicit
